thread:
Maya (PM): Quick thread to land a tenant-centric rollout for routing-v2. FinReg wants explicit opt-in + staged experiments. We need clear buckets, guardrails, and a customer-safe kill ladder. Thoughts?
Jon (Eng): I propose 'tenant slices' not percent-only ramps. Start with internal + 2 enterprise beta tenants -> 10 small tenants -> 100 random tenants -> global. Each step has a watch window.
Priya (SRE): Define watch windows and automated gate rules: short window (10m) for tiny slices, longer (3h) for larger. Auto-fail if: p95 > baseline*1.25 sustained 10m OR 5xxs spike > 3x baseline in 5m OR model-quality-check fails on smoke set.
Marco (ProdOps): For FinReg, create a customer-facing opt-in toggle in Console and an explicit whitelist. We should also add a "pause-and-notify" flag so Customer Success can freeze an individual tenant mid-rollout.
Hannah (QA): Must shadow customer traffic for 72h before any tenant joins the beta. Run the customer-specific eval suite and collect per-tenant quality deltas. Block if accuracy drop > 1.0% or NPS-impact signals.
Jon (Eng): Fallback chain: routing-v2 (full) -> routing-v2-quant (8-bit) -> fallback-router (routing-v1). Implement gradual degrade: first switch to quantized for offending AZ, if still bad, back to v1 regionally.
Maya (PM): Also embed a low-cost experiment: for 20% of the 100-random-tenants cohort, A/B test v2-full vs v2-quant to capture cost vs quality tradeoffs. Instrumented metrics: quality_score, cost_per_1k_tokens, latency_p95.
Priya (SRE): Observability checklist: live dashboard for cohort-level p50/p95/p99, errors, throttles, tokens/sec, cache-hit-rate, cost/1k, and an eval-quality boolean. Alerts map to runbooks: slow->paged, quality->page + auto-rollback candidate.
Marco (ProdOps): Example flag payload (for rollout service):
```
{"flag":"routing.v2.enabled","default":false,"slices":[{"name":"internal","tenants":["redwood-prod","canary-team"]},{"name":"beta","tenants":["finreg-01"]},{"name":"rand-100","pct":100}]}
```
Hannah (QA): Acceptance criteria per step: latency_p95 <= baseline*1.15, error_rate < 0.15%, quality_score delta <= 0.8%. Sign-off required from Eng + SRE + CS lead before progressing past 'beta'.
Jon (Eng): Implement immediate kill-switch `routing.v2.kill` that forces traffic to fallback-router. Make rollouts idempotent and annotate audit log with who triggered changes. Also add per-tenant threshold overrides for FinReg.
Priya (SRE): Automation: rollout-bot will monitor configured gates and, on breach, annotate timeline, execute kill if configured, and open incident stub with pre-filled template. We should simulate automated rollback in staging first.
rollout-bot: [automation] Will post progress updates, metrics snapshots, and execute `routing.v2.kill` when gate rules are violated.
Maya (PM): Comms: Marco to draft a short customer-facing note: what to expect, how to opt-in/out, and notification cadence on issues. Also a templated 'we rolled back' message with root-cause placeholder.
Marco (ProdOps): Will draft comms + console copy. Also need a runbook: how to remap a tenant quickly, and an ops checklist to notify CS and legal for FinReg customers.
Hannah (QA): Test matrix: shadow 72h, dry-run kill-switch 1x, canary ramp 1->10->100 with acceptance checks between steps, post-roll 7-day quality monitor.
Maya (PM): Launch criteria summary for PRD: (1) 72h shadow with no quality blocks, (2) all acceptance checks pass for initial beta tenants, (3) A/B experiment producing statistically-significant cost/quality delta for 20% cohort, (4) kill-switch and automation tested in staging.
Jon (Eng): Delivery items and owners: feature-flag API + audit (Jon, Thu), fallback-router chain (Jon, Fri), per-tenant thresholds (Jon, next Wed).
Priya (SRE): SRE items: dashboards + alerts (Priya, Mon), simulate auto-rollback in staging (Priya, Tue).
Marco (ProdOps): Ops items: console toggle + whitelist (Marco, Mon), customer comms + runbook (Marco, Tue).
Hannah (QA): QA items: shadow harness + tests (Hannah, Tue).
Maya (PM): OK I'll add these to the PRD rollout section and tag owners. If no objections we'll kick off the staging dry-run next week.
Jon (Eng): good.
Priya (SRE): fine.
Marco (ProdOps): 👍
Hannah (QA): ready on my side.
Maya (PM): Thanks everyone 44d I'll post the PRD link when updated.
